Map Hill numbers (and coverage) in geographic space

plot_geo.Rd

Plots site-level diversity estimates as points on an sf map, with an optional raster backdrop. Uses theme_tidymapr() and the colour-blind-safe Okabe-Ito / viridis scales.

Usage

plot_geo(
  data,
  value = NULL,
  lon = lon,
  lat = lat,
  basemap = "esri",
  raster = NULL,
  coastline = NULL,
  size = 3,
  label = NULL,
  scale_bar = TRUE,
  north_arrow = TRUE,
  scale_bar_km = NULL,
  scale_units = c("metric", "imperial", "both"),
  legend_title = NULL,
  legend_position = "auto",
  legend_frame = TRUE,
  inset = FALSE,
  admin = NULL,
  admin_level = 1,
  admin_fill = FALSE
)

Arguments

data

An sf object or a data frame with lon/lat and an estimate column (for example the output of tidydiversity::div_estimate() joined to coordinates with tidydiversity::add_site_data() / geo_as_sf()).

value

<data-masking> Column to map (fill / size).

lon, lat

Coordinate columns when data is not sf.

basemap

Basemap: "none", "coast", tile name, SpatRaster or path. See geo_basemap().

raster

Optional SpatRaster backdrop (used when basemap is "none").

coastline

Optional coastline sf for a coast basemap.

size

Point size, or a bare column mapped to point size (combined with value like tmap size + col, e.g. Hill number and elevation).

label

Optional column of site labels.

scale_bar, north_arrow

Draw a scale bar and north arrow? TRUE uses the default style, FALSE none, or name a style (see annotation_scale_bar()).

scale_bar_km

Length of the scale bar in kilometres.

scale_units

Scale bar units: "metric", "imperial" or "both".

legend_title

Optional legend title (defaults to the value column).

legend_position

"auto" (collision-aware inside corner), "outside", or a corner "bl" / "br" / "tl" / "tr".

legend_frame

Draw a frame around an inside legend?

inset

Overview map: FALSE, TRUE/"auto", "png", or a length-4 bbox. Uses the same collision reservation as the scale bar and north arrow. PNG insets prefer GADM provinces when cached.

admin

Optional administrative boundaries (sf or ISO3 code); see plot_sites().

admin_level

GADM level when admin is a country code.

admin_fill

Fill admin polygons instead of outlines only.

Value

A ggplot object with attribute tmr_decoration.

Examples

est <- tibble::tibble(
  site = c("a", "b", "c"),
  lon = c(147.0, 147.2, 147.4),
  lat = c(-9.4, -9.5, -9.6),
  diversity = c(12, 18, 9)
)
plot_geo(est, diversity, lon, lat, basemap = "coast", label = site)
